title: Wyeast file_types.json
description: Single source of truth for file-type handling. PERMISSIVE on purpose: additionalProperties is NOT false, so new disposition categories / engine sets validate without a schema bump. Each disposition declares the extensions of a file kind and the action to take at intake; engine_sets are named extension lists consumed by individual stages. Structural cross-checks (e.g. extensions are lowercase dot-prefixed, image/video/pdf disjoint) live in tools/preflight.py and tests/unit/test_filetypes.py.

extensions.description: Array of dot-prefixed extensions, or an object mapping extension -> handler key (archives).

names.description: Exact filenames matched before extension (e.g. intake metadata).

name_patterns.description: Case-insensitive fnmatch globs on the basename, checked before any extension match (e.g. message exports living on generic .xml/.json/.txt extensions).

engine_sets.description: name -> array of dot-prefixed extensions (string values like _note are ignored by readers).

skip_dirs.description: Intake directory-prune policy: top-level OS/system subtrees skipped from stage-01 collection (kept in place + reported, not deleted), gated by a root_marker so it only fires on a system volume. Overridable per-case via case_config.json.
